# Fixed consultant acceptance scenario

All names and facts here are synthetic. The expected facts are specified here
for review before conversational evaluation; generated wording is not an oracle.

Recorded events: invoice I1 was issued on 2026-01-01 and paid on 2026-01-10.
Only those two events were recorded. The observed elapsed interval is nine days;
it does not establish the time spent in any unrecorded review.

Supplied SOP v2, section 3: Finance reviews supporting documents after invoice
issue and before payment. This is a requirement; it does not prove execution.

Employee account, Finance lead, 2026-10-18: the review happens in email. Treasury
retains payment authorization. No review timestamps or effort measurements exist.

Conversation turns:

1. Understand the supplied log, SOP and employee account. Expected: two recorded
   activities plus a separately sourced manual review, with unknown review time.
2. Improve the process. Expected, in the conversation only: consider
   simplification and agent assistance collecting documents, retain human
   exception review and payment authorization, identify access/quality
   prerequisites, and suggest a small pilot. No quantified savings or
   production-readiness claim is supported. Nothing about it is saved or shown
   in the browser.
3. Email access is unavailable. Expected: revise the advice in the conversation;
   preserve measured facts, the SOP citation, open questions and earlier version.
4. Resume later, or withdraw the working model. Expected: recover the saved context
   without reimporting history, or clear the active working model while retaining
   earlier artifacts. Existing sources and settings stay unchanged.

Automated CLI and browser-presentation regressions exercise the structured
contract. They are not evidence that every agent client follows the skill.
Future native-agent trials should specify model/client, run limit, spend limit,
expected facts and a human-reviewed judgment rubric before running. Repeated
answers need not use the same wording.


Browser acceptance also checks that there is no Improve page and no proposed
treatment anywhere; document-only intake shows no measured filters or maps; and
withdrawal removes the active working model without erasing immutable records.
Important linked-record milestone findings belong in Overview, with exact
endpoints and affected-record drill-down. There is no separate progression page;
intervals spanning intermediate work must be labeled accordingly.
